claims_used: 2 kW initial and 20 kW future node designs; more than 400 hours internal reserves while supporting external payloads; deployment targeted for 2028.
interpretation: 400-hour darkness is an analyst stress scenario, not the stated reserve duration's verified operating condition. Advertised reserve duration gives neither customer load nor battery capacity.
assumptions: 120/240 kWh nominal battery, 50 W housekeeping, 50 W continuous customers, 90 percent delivery efficiency, 95 percent charge and discharge efficiency, initial SOC 90 percent, minimum SOC 20 percent, maximum SOC 95 percent, 20 kW battery power limits, 120-hour recharge interval. Synthetic two-block illumination, no lunar terrain observations.
